ON MUNICIPAL SERVICE IN THE CITY OF MOSCOW

this law governs relations connected with the organization of municipal service in the city of moscow; entry into municipal service by citizens of the russian federation and by citizens of foreign states that are parties to international treaties of the russian federation under which foreign citizens may perform municipal service (hereinafter, citizens); the conditions and procedure for performing and terminating municipal service; and the determination of the legal position (status) of municipal servants of intra-city municipal entities in the city of moscow (hereinafter, municipal servants). this law does not determine the status of holders of municipal offices, because they are not municipal servants. beginning of document
